_note: PROVISIONAL NooPunk technique catalogue. The mechanics follow the psionic shape adopted in rulebook/WITHOUT_NUMBER_BASELINE.md section 6 (core capability, individually learned techniques, Effort commitment). Every technique name and every sentence of effect text here is original NooPunk content: Stars Without Number has no verified SRD licence, so none of its power names, tables or prose is reproduced (docs/licenses/ISSUE_569_WITHOUT_NUMBER_RIGHTS.md). The author owns every number in this file; IS_CANONICAL is false until ruled otherwise.
source_shape: SWN Revised psionics (mechanics re-expressed) + WWN SRD Effort pattern (CC0)

Biopsionics.name: Mending Touch
Biopsionics.effect: Restore 1d6 + Biopsionics skill in hit points to a touched subject. A mortally wounded subject stabilizes instead of healing. Once per subject per scene.

Metapsionics.name: Weave Sight
Metapsionics.effect: Sense whether psionic effects are active within 30 metres and in which direction, but not who or what caused them.

Precognition.name: Hunch
Precognition.effect: Ask one question about what is about to happen in the next few minutes. The answer is a fragment: yes, no, both, or a single image. It is evidence, never a verdict.

Telekinesis.name: Lift
Telekinesis.effect: Move up to ten kilograms within ten metres without touching it. Fine manipulation is impossible; a held object cannot be used as a weapon.

Telepathy.name: Surface Read
Telepathy.effect: Read the dominant emotion and immediate intent of a visible mind. The subject feels an unnamed unease, not the reading itself.

Teleportation.name: Blink
Teleportation.effect: Shift up to three metres to a point you can see. You cannot arrive inside solid matter; if you cannot see the destination, you cannot go.

techniques.name: Staunch
techniques.effect: Stabilize a mortally wounded subject you can touch, with no check. The subject still recovers as a stabilized mortal wound does.

techniques.name: Purge
techniques.effect: Neutralize one poison or disease in a touched subject on a successful check. Congenital conditions are not affected.

techniques.name: Rebuild
techniques.effect: After an hour of work, remove the Frail condition from one subject. The hour is spent whether or not the subject later relapses.

techniques.name: Dampen
techniques.effect: One named psionic effect on a subject you can see ends if you beat its user in an opposed WIS/Metapsionics check. If the effect has no user present, the difficulty is 9.

techniques.name: Torch Shield
techniques.effect: While this is committed, roll twice when you torch and take the better result.

techniques.name: Sever
techniques.effect: End every sustained psionic effect on one subject. Each effect beyond the first raises the difficulty by 1.

techniques.name: Danger Sense
techniques.effect: Add +2 to your initiative and +1 to both Armor Classes for the scene. You cannot be surprised.

techniques.name: Flash Forward
techniques.effect: Act first in the round regardless of initiative. If another combatant also acts first, resolve between you normally.

techniques.name: Probability Lock
techniques.effect: Reroll one check you have just failed, keeping the second result. Declaring it after the dice are known is the point.

techniques.name: Shove
techniques.effect: Push a target up to ten metres away: 1d6 damage and a chance to knock them prone. Resolve as a normal attack against Evasion AC.

techniques.name: Barrier
techniques.effect: Add +2 Melee AC against incoming attacks. The barrier is invisible and provides no cover against suppressive fire.

techniques.name: Crush
techniques.effect: 2d6 damage to one target at close range, ignoring armor's Damage Soak. This attack can inflict a Traumatic Hit.

techniques.name: Thread
techniques.effect: A silent two-way link with one willing mind within 100 metres. Words only; no images, no commands.

techniques.name: Command
techniques.effect: One short imperative that the subject must obey unless it would obviously kill them. A Mental save resists. Using this without consent is an assault, in law and in the fiction.

techniques.name: Deep Scan
techniques.effect: Read one specific memory from a touched mind. A subject who passes a Mental save knows a scan was attempted and by whom.

techniques.name: Step
techniques.effect: Shift up to thirty metres to a point you can see. Arriving inside solid matter is impossible.

techniques.name: Carry
techniques.effect: Take one willing touched person with you on a teleportation you are already performing.

techniques.name: Fold
techniques.effect: Travel up to one kilometre to a place you have seen before. A failed check means you arrive somewhere close but wrong, and the referee decides where.

techniques.name: Empathic Trace
techniques.effect: Read the emotional residue a person left on a place or an object they handled. The trace is a feeling and a rough impression of intent, never a name, a face or a memory.

techniques.name: Premonition
techniques.effect: A warning of immediate danger: one sentence about the next few seconds, true but always incomplete. It cannot be repeated for the same danger.
